newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukrainian president drastically reshuffles cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Ukrainian president drastically reshuffles cabinet.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma on Friday radicially reshuffled his government following the appointment of a new prime minister earlier this month.

According to a string of presidential decrees, Kuchma replaced the ministers of economy, agriculture, energy, coal mining and industry -- the key areas for reforms. The ministers of defence, interior and finance and the deputy prime minister in charge of economic reforms all retained their posts.
Earlier this month Kuchma appointed a close ally, pragmatist Valery Pustovoitenko, as prime minister after accepting the resignation of Pavlo Lazarenko.
Under the constitution, Kuchma is obliged to form a new cabinet following the appointment of a new head of government.
A presidential spokesman said that more appointments were expected later on Friday.
